name: Insula (multi-storey apartment block with shops)
license: original procedural geometry (TIMELINES Studio); materials use CC0 Poly Haven textures, see data/textures/LICENSES.json
source: procedural bpy generator tl_buildings.py / tl_nature.py (via build_assets.py)
historical_accuracy_notes: Ground-floor tabernae and upper flats around a light court, as at Ostia. v2 (2026-11-26): street facades are modelled - shop openings 2.3-3.0 m wide and 1.7 m deep (some with masonry counters, shutter boards or amphorae), stair doors, windows recessed 0.3 m with sills and open/closed timber shutters, string course, two-step eave cornice, timber balconies (maeniana) on joists or tile pent roofs on brackets; roofs carry modelled imbrices and ridge tiles; long blocks split into two masses of different height; plaster palette (ochre, cream, faded red, grey) with brick showing through. Party walls and light-court walls keep shaded (not modelled) windows. ESTIMATES: floor heights (3.7-4.3 m ground, 2.9-3.3 m upper), opening sizes and rhythms, balcony depth (1.15 m).
references: Ostia Antica insulae (e.g. Casa di Diana, 2nd c. CE)
